name: Evergreen
seo_title: Evergreen Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Evergreen, CO: Holiday Walk, Winterfest, Frostival at Evergreen Lake, Santa Breakfast and the Conifer parade.
lede: Evergreen turns its mountain downtown and lake into a holiday village, with a lit tree, closed streets, lakeside skating and a Christmas parade in neighboring Conifer.
celebrates: Evergreen celebrates with the Downtown Evergreen Holiday Walk, where Santa and Mrs. Claus light the holiday tree and downtown streets close for the evening. The Evergreen Park and Recreation District keeps its lake house and Dedisse Park busy with a December holiday event, and the Evergreen Chamber of Commerce runs a Santa Breakfast. Winterfest at the Center for the Arts Evergreen, the Frostival and the Conifer Christmas Parade round out the season, and Conifer sits within the same mountain community.
lastyear: The 33rd Annual Holiday Walk in 2025 took place on Friday, December 5, from 5 to 9 pm in downtown Evergreen, according to the Evergreen Chamber. Santa and Mrs. Claus light the holiday tree and the streets close for the evening. Evergreen Park and Recreation's holiday event at the lake ran on weekends in December, with skating weather depending, and the lake's New Year's Eve Icefest ran on December 31, 2025, from noon to 6 pm.
facts: The Holiday Walk is a long-running tradition: the 2026 edition is the 34th annual, and downtown Evergreen describes it as a nostalgic way to kick off the holiday season. The Evergreen Lake House is the official kickoff location for several of the town's winter events, and the lake's New Year's Eve Icefest is described as a long-standing family-friendly, alcohol-free tradition for the community.
trains: Evergreen has no passenger train of its own, but the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden is about a half hour away and carries a Polar Express train ride in the Christmas season. The Georgetown Loop Railroad, farther up Interstate 70, runs Santa's Lighted Forest night train with more than 300,000 lights from November 6 to December 24, 2026.

faq: When is the Evergreen Holiday Walk?

The 34th Annual Holiday Walk is a downtown Evergreen tradition where Santa and Mrs. Claus light the holiday tree and the streets are closed for the evening. The 2025 walk ran from 5 to 9 pm on the first Friday of December. See the event card for the 2026 date and details.
Is there ice skating in Evergreen?

Evergreen Lake offers skating when the weather allows, and Evergreen Park and Recreation's annual holiday event at the lake house runs on weekends in December with skating, shopping and more. The district lists ice conditions on its own pages, so check before you drive up.
Is the Conifer Christmas Parade part of Evergreen?

Conifer is a neighboring mountain community. This page carries the 43rd Annual Conifer Christmas Parade because Conifer is too small for its own page and families in both towns attend. The event card lists the host, date and route details.

Santa and Mrs. Claus appear at the Downtown Evergreen Holiday Walk, and the Evergreen Chamber runs a Santa Breakfast where seats are reserved ahead. SantaAndMrs.com also keeps a calendar of Santa and Mrs. Claus appearances around Evergreen each year.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Evergreen for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from the Downtown Holiday Walk (December 4) through the Frostival at Evergreen Lake (December 12), with Winterfest and the Conifer Christmas Parade (both December 5) and the Santa Breakfast (December 6) in between. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Evergreen

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Evergreen and Conifer
  • 3 free events: Winterfest, the Frostival and the Conifer Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: the Holiday Walk, Winterfest and the Santa Breakfast ($28 per person)
  • Parades and lights: the 34th Annual Holiday Walk tree lighting and the 43rd Annual Conifer Christmas Parade
  • Season: December 4 to December 12, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Evergreen families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Denver, which covers Zoo Lights, Blossoms of Light at the Denver Botanic Gardens and the big downtown tree lightings.
